start.speaker: Rook
start.text: You're asking questions in the wrong bar, detective.

who.speaker: Rook
who.text: Nobody. Just a man who keeps the peace for people who matter.

press.speaker: Rook
press.text: ...The tab was paid as a favor. What happened after isn't your concern. Drop it — for your health.

discover.title: Rook's Threat
discover.desc: Kanzaki's enforcer warned you off pressing the tab — all but confirming the syndicate cleaned up after the victim.

bye.speaker: Rook
bye.text: Smart. Rain'll wash you out of here either way.
